items.colloc: cost containment 成本控制 | containment strategy 抑制策略
items.distinct: restriction 限制 | prevention 預防
ex: Strict cost containment measures were introduced last month.
上個月實施了嚴格的成本控制措施。
The manager proposed a new containment strategy today.
經理今天提出了一項新的抑制策略。
Effective containment of expenses is vital for survival.
有效控制費用對於企業生存至關重要。

items.colloc: austerity measure 緊縮措施 | austerity plan 緊縮計劃
items.distinct: economy 經濟 | poverty 貧困
ex: The company implemented strict austerity measures this year.
該公司今年實施了嚴格的緊縮措施。
Employees prepared for the newly announced austerity plan.
員工們為新宣布的緊縮計劃做好了準備。
Austerity policies helped the firm reduce its debt.
緊縮政策幫助該公司減少了債務。

items.colloc: retrenchment policy 緊縮政策 | forced retrenchment 強制裁員
items.distinct: downsizing 精簡規模 | lay-off 解僱
ex: The firm announced a major retrenchment program today.
該公司今天宣布了一項重大裁員與緊縮計劃。
Retrenchment became necessary after several quarters of losses.
在連續幾個季度虧損後，緊縮開支變得不可避免。
Many departments faced budget cuts during the retrenchment.
許多部門在緊縮期間面臨預算削減。

items.pos: adj. 低於預算的 | adv. 低於預算地
items.colloc: remain underbudget 保持低於預算 | underbudget operation 低於預算運作
items.distinct: overbudget 超出預算 | balanced 預算平衡的
ex: The renovation project was completed underbudget and on time.
翻新工程低於預算並按時完成。
Our team managed to keep operational costs underbudget.
我們團隊成功將營運成本保持在預算以下。
She received a bonus for finishing underbudget.
她因完成項目且低於預算而獲得獎金。

items.pos: n. 超出預算；超支 | v. 超出；泛濫
items.colloc: cost overrun 成本超支 | budget overrun 預算超支
items.distinct: deficit 赤字 | excess 過量
ex: Unexpected delays caused a severe cost overrun on site.
意外的延誤導致現場嚴重的成本超支。
The board requested an explanation for the budget overrun.
董事會要求對預算超支作出解釋。
Careful monitoring can prevent potential cost overruns early.
仔細的監控可以提早預防潛在的成本超支。

items.colloc: streamline operations 精簡營運 | streamline workflow 簡化工作流程
items.distinct: simplify 簡化 | optimize 最佳化
ex: We must streamline operations to reduce redundant overhead.
我們必須精簡營運以減少多餘的經常性費用。
The new software will streamline our accounting workflow.
這套新軟體將簡化我們的會計工作流程。
Consultants advised us to streamline the supply chain.
顧問建議我們精簡供應鏈。

items.colloc: economize on resources 節約資源 | economize fuel 節省燃料
items.distinct: save 儲蓄 | preserve 保存
ex: The director asked every department to economize immediately.
處長要求每個部門立即實行節約。
We can economize on electricity by using LED lighting.
我們可以透過使用 LED 照明來節省電費。
Small businesses must economize during economic downturns.
小企業在經濟衰退期間必須節約開支。

items.colloc: curtailment of expenditure 支出削減 | production curtailment 產量縮減
items.distinct: reduction 減少 | termination 終止
ex: The curtailment of travel expenses saved substantial money.
差旅費用的削減節省了大幅資金。
Further curtailment of research funds may hinder innovation.
研究基金的進一步削減可能會阻礙創新。
Management announced a temporary curtailment of overtime work.
管理層宣布暫時縮減加班時間。

items.pos: n. 可行性；實行可能性
items.colloc: feasibility study 可行性研究 | financial feasibility 財務可行性
items.distinct: viability 生存能力 | possibility 可能性
ex: We conducted a feasibility study before committing any funds.
我們在投入資金前進行了可行性研究。
The board questioned the financial feasibility of the expansion.
董事會質疑該擴建案的財務可行性。
High costs rendered the project's feasibility quite low.
高昂的成本使得該項目的可行性相當低。

items.colloc: operational efficiency 營運效率 | energy efficiency 能源效率
items.distinct: effectiveness 效果 | productivity 生產力
ex: Improving operational efficiency is key to controlling costs.
提高營運效率是控制成本的關鍵。
The new automated system boosted overall factory efficiency.
新的自動化系統提高了工廠的整體效率。
They are seeking ways to enhance cost efficiency.
他們正在尋找提高成本效益的方法。

items.colloc: financial scrutiny 財務審查 | close scrutiny 嚴格檢查
items.distinct: inspection 檢查 | audit 審計
ex: All departmental budgets are now under financial scrutiny.
所有部門預算現在都在接受財務審查。
The manager subjected every expense claim to close scrutiny.
經理對每一筆報帳申請都進行了嚴格審查。
Greater public scrutiny forced the company to cut wasteful spending.
更嚴格的公眾監督迫使該公司減少浪費性支出。

items.colloc: rationalize expenditure 成本合理化 | rationalize structure 結構合理化
items.distinct: justify 正當化 | reorganize 重組
ex: Management decided to rationalize operating costs across branches.
管理層決定使各分行的營運成本合理化。
The company will rationalize its supply chain to save money.
該公司將整頓其供應鏈以節省資金。
Efforts to rationalize production processes yielded immediate results.
使生產流程合理化的努力立即見效。

items.pos: n. 不當分配；配置錯誤
items.colloc: misallocation of resources 資源配置不當 | budget misallocation 預算分配錯誤
items.distinct: maladministration 管理不善 | waste 浪費
ex: The audit revealed a serious misallocation of capital.
審計揭露了嚴重的資本配置錯誤。
Avoiding the misallocation of resources is crucial for managers.
避免資源分配不當對管理者來說至關重要。
Misallocation of funds led to project failure last year.
資金分配不當導致了去年項目的失敗。

items.colloc: waste elimination 消除浪費 | cost elimination 成本消除
items.distinct: removal 移除 | reduction 減少
ex: Waste elimination is the primary goal of lean manufacturing.
消除浪費是精益製造的首要目標。
The gradual elimination of redundant positions cut labor costs.
逐漸消除冗餘職位降低了人力成本。
Strict quality control leads to the elimination of defects.
嚴格的品質管制可以消除缺陷。

items.colloc: financial prudence 財務審慎 | exercise prudence 保持審慎
items.distinct: caution 謹慎 | economy 節儉
ex: Financial prudence helped the company survive the market crisis.
財務上的審慎幫助該公司度過了市場危機。
Executives must exercise financial prudence when planning next year.
主管們在規劃明年時必須保持財務審慎。
Her prudence in budgeting prevented any unwanted expenditure.
她在預算編列上的審慎避免了不必要的支出。
